_note: Checked-in routing corpus for architecture-decomposer. CAVEAT: routing-eval measures LEXICAL TOKEN OVERLAP ONLY — a legibility aid, not a verdict. The indirect/paraphrase positives (the last 2-3) are deliberately low-overlap to test recall; a lexical miss on them is a PROXY artifact, NOT a description defect. The negatives are ADVERSARIAL: each is a real trigger for a NAMED confusable sibling. Every *-decomposer here shares the 'decompose / design / grade on two crossing axes' vocabulary, so the family collides on surface tokens by construction. This skill owns the ARCHITECTURE (system/service/module graph, boundaries, the dependency graph, cycles, layering); code-decomposer owns a UNIT OF CODE inside one module; component-decomposer owns a ZERO-DEP WEB COMPONENT; layout-decomposer owns a UI LAYOUT; proof-decomposer owns a deductive argument. The graduated source skill arch-system shared this whole territory; the negatives surface exactly the family collisions. Re-derive when the neighbourhood changes.
